According to DOC-038: display name change is cosmetic only, does not change workspace URL, API base path, identifiers any integration or webhook references. Also integration continues to point same workspace, no reconfiguration needed. The only place old name may persist is email addresses or subdomains set up separately, not automatically updated.

Thus answer: No, renaming does not affect URLs, webhook endpoints, integration references; they remain same; only display name changes; you may need to manually update email addresses/subdomains if used.
